caption: Tip-to-tail addition of the two series voltages: 20 V at 0° plus 15 V at 60° gives the dashed resultant 30.4 V at 25.3°. The dashed arrow is the diagonal of the parallelogram.

spec.aria: Two phasors drawn tip to tail, 20 V at 0 degrees and then 15 V at 60 degrees, with the dashed resultant from the origin at 30.4 V and 25.3 degrees.
